direction.tooltip: Whether to append audio2 after or before audio1.

AudioConcat.name: AudioConcat
AudioConcat.description: Concatenates the audio1 to audio2 in the specified direction.

selection.tooltip: Method used to choose key blocks for full token-level attention. sol-attn: Sparsifying Online Attention uses a training-free adaptive threshold for each attention head and query block. sla: Sparse-Linear Attention keeps a fixed percentage of the highest-scoring key blocks; use only with model weights trained for this pattern. vsa: Video Sparse Attention (FastVideo) uses 3D video-cube tiling and a learned coarse attention branch; requires FastH3 model weights.

tau.tooltip: Threshold in score-distribution sigmas. Higher is sparser: 1.0 keeps ~16% of key blocks exact, 1.5 ~7%, 2.0 ~2.7%.

keep_percent.tooltip: Percent of key blocks each query block keeps exactly (sinks and the diagonal ride on top). The selection SLA-style LoRAs are distilled against; without such a LoRA higher is closer to dense.
Percent of video cubes each query cube keeps; FastH3-VSA checkpoints are trained at 10. Uses the model's to_gate_compress layers for the coarse branch when present.

start_percent.tooltip: Percentage point when sparse attention begins. Before this point, attention stays dense.

end_percent.tooltip: Percentage point when sparse attention ends. After this point, attention returns to dense.

dense_blocks.tooltip: Transformer blocks that always run dense, e.g. '0, 1, 47-49'.

min_tokens.tooltip: Sequences shorter than this stay dense.

extra_tokens.tooltip: Extra top-scoring tokens each query block attends beyond its selected blocks. Closer to dense for more attention time; 256 recommended, 0 disables. Ignored for VSA.

sink_conditioning.tooltip: MiniMax-H3 only. exact_kv: every query attends the packed text/audio/reference rows exactly (~3% cost). exact_kv_and_rows: additionally runs the target-audio query rows dense (keeps generated audio intact).

verbose.tooltip: Logs whether each attention shape used sparse attention or why it stayed dense.

output_tooltips: The model with block-sparse attention applied.
BlockSparseAttention.name: BlockSparseAttention
BlockSparseAttention.description: Applies block-sparse attention to eligible model attention layers, reducing compute for long sequences. The speed gain grows with sequence length since short sequences are usually faster dense. Outside the start/end_percent, dense_blocks and under min_tokens, the model uses the dense model attention backend. Use the node Model Attention Backend to select that fallback.

pre_cfg.tooltip: If true, rescale the combined noise BEFORE the sampler's CFG combine, without clamping (can amplify). Matches the norm-scaled CFG used by models like Lens. Default false keeps the original post-CFG x0-space attenuate-only behavior.

CLIPLoader.name: CLIPLoader
CLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:
sd: clip-l
stable cascade: clip-g
sd3: t5 xxl / clip-g / clip-l
stable audio: t5 base
mochi: t5 xxl
cogvideox: t5 xxl (226-token padding)
cosmos: old t5 xxl
lumina2: gemma 2 2B
wan: umt5 xxl
hidream: llama-3.1 (Recommend) or t5
omnigen2: qwen vl 2.5 3B
joyimage: qwen3-vl 8B
lens: gpt-oss-20b
pixeldit: gemma 2 2B elm
minimax: MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL or Music3 Qwen/RVQ
flux3: qwen3-vl 4B
fibo2: qwen3-vl 4B

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

CLIPTextEncode.name: CLIPTextEncode
CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.
output_tooltips: A conditioning containing the embedded text used to guide the diffusion model.

ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

CheckpointLoaderSimple.name: CheckpointLoaderSimple
CheckpointLoaderSimple.description: Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.
output_tooltips: The model used for denoising latents.
The CLIP model used for encoding text prompts.
The VAE model used for encoding and decoding images to and from latent space.

DualCLIPLoader.name: DualCLIPLoader
DualCLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:
sdxl: clip-l, clip-g
sd3: clip-l, clip-g / clip-l, t5 / clip-g, t5
flux: clip-l, t5
hidream: at least one of t5 or llama, recommended t5 and llama
hunyuan_image: qwen2.5vl 7b and byt5 small
newbie: gemma-3-4b-it, jina clip v2

model.tooltip: The model to add EasyCache to.

reuse_threshold.tooltip: The threshold for reusing cached steps.

start_percent.tooltip: The relative sampling step to begin use of EasyCache.

end_percent.tooltip: The relative sampling step to end use of EasyCache.

width.tooltip: The width of the latent images in pixels.

height.tooltip: The height of the latent images in pixels.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

EmptyLatentImage.name: EmptyLatentImage
EmptyLatentImage.description: Create a new batch of empty latent images to be denoised via sampling.

video.tooltip: The video to extract components from.

GetVideoComponents.name: GetVideoComponents
GetVideoComponents.description: Extracts video frames, audio, frame rate, bit depth, and color space.

noise_mask.tooltip: Add a noise mask to the latent so sampling will only happen within the mask. Might improve results or completely break things depending on the model.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

KSampler.name: KSampler
KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

LTXVConcatAVLatent.name: LTXVConcatAVLatent
LTXVConcatAVLatent.description: Merge a video latent and an audio latent into a joint AV latent (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).

LTXVSeparateAVLatent.name: LTXVSeparateAVLatent
LTXVSeparateAVLatent.description: Split a joint AV latent into its video and audio latents (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).

model.tooltip: The diffusion model the LoRA will be applied to.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model the LoRA will be applied to.

strength_model.tooltip: How strongly to modify the diffusion model. This value can be negative.

strength_clip.tooltip: How strongly to modify the CLIP model. This value can be negative.

LoraLoader.name: LoraLoader
LoraLoader.description: This LoRA loader is used to modify both diffusion and CLIP models, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

LoraLoaderModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderModelOnly
LoraLoaderModelOnly.description: This LoRAs loader is used to modify the diffusion model, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

attention.tooltip: The dense attention backend. Comfy Kitchen attention uses quantized INT8 attention and is available only on Nvidia and AMD GPUs.

output_tooltips: The model with the selected attention backend.
ModelAttentionBackend.name: ModelAttentionBackend
ModelAttentionBackend.description: Selects the dense attention implementation for the model. When used with Block Sparse Attention, this backend is used whenever sparse attention is inactive or unsupported.

noise_scale.tooltip: Absolute training noise scale. For example HiDream-O1 base: 8.0, dev: 7.5.

model.tooltip: The model to apply NAG to.

nag_scale.tooltip: The guidance scale factor. Higher values push further from the negative prompt.

nag_alpha.tooltip: Blending factor for the normalized attention. 1.0 is full replacement, 0.0 is no effect.

output_tooltips: The patched model with NAG enabled.
NAGuidance.name: NAGuidance
NAGuidance.description: Applies Normalized Attention Guidance to models, enabling negative prompts on distilled/schnell models.

start_frame_count.tooltip: Number of latent frames to normalize, counted from the start

reference_frame_count.tooltip: Number of latent frames after the start frames to use as reference

NormalizeVideoLatentStart.name: NormalizeVideoLatentStart
NormalizeVideoLatentStart.description: Normalizes the initial frames of a video latent to match the mean and standard deviation of subsequent reference frames. Helps reduce differences between the starting frames and the rest of the video.

PreviewImage.name: PreviewImage
PreviewImage.description: Preview the images without saving them to the ComfyUI output directory.

ReferenceLatent.name: ReferenceLatent
ReferenceLatent.description: This node sets the guiding latent for an edit model. If the model supports it you can chain multiple to set multiple reference images.

destination.tooltip: The destination latent where frames will be replaced.

index.tooltip: The starting latent frame index in the destination latent where the source latent frames will be placed. Negative values count from the end.

source.tooltip: The source latent providing frames to insert into the destination latent. If not provided, the destination latent is returned unchanged.

resize_type.tooltip: Select how to resize: by exact dimensions, scale factor, matching another image, etc.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from height while preserving aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from width while preserving aspect ratio.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

multiplier.tooltip: Scale factor (e.g., 2.0 doubles size, 0.5 halves size).

longer_size.tooltip: The longer edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

shorter_size.tooltip: The shorter edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Height auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Width auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels (e.g., 1.0 ≈ 1024×1024). Aspect ratio is preserved.

match.tooltip: Resize input to match the dimensions of this reference image or mask.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

multiple.tooltip: Resize so width and height are divisible by this number. Useful for latent alignment (e.g., 8 or 64).

scale_method.tooltip: Interpolation algorithm. 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling, 'nearest-exact' for pixel art.

ResizeImageMaskNode.name: ResizeImageMaskNode
ResizeImageMaskNode.description: Resize an image or mask using various scaling methods.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. May include formatting tokens such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd%.

format.tooltip: The file format in which to save the audio.

SaveAudioAdvanced.name: SaveAudioAdvanced
SaveAudioAdvanced.description: Saves the input audio to your ComfyUI output directory.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

SaveImage.name: SaveImage
SaveImage.description: Saves the input images to your ComfyUI output directory.

SwarmAttnTokenWeights.name: SwarmAttnTokenWeights
SwarmAttnTokenWeights.description: Applies per-token prompt weights through Comfy's attn1_patch (value scale / attention bias) instead of replacing attention.forward.

prefix_duration.tooltip: Seconds of silence to encode and mask off at the start of the audio latent.

suffix_duration.tooltip: Seconds of silence to encode and mask off at the end of the audio latent.

SwarmAudioSilentMaskPrefixSuffix.name: SwarmAudioSilentMaskPrefixSuffix
SwarmAudioSilentMaskPrefixSuffix.description: Encodes silent audio and writes it into the start and/or end of a latent audio clip, masking that prefix/suffix so sampling cannot update it.

SwarmCleanOverlapMasksExceptSelf.name: SwarmCleanOverlapMasksExceptSelf
SwarmCleanOverlapMasksExceptSelf.description: If masks have been overmerged, this takes a single mask and grabs just the CleanOverlap result for the one mask relative to the overmerge result.

match_text.tooltip: A short description (a few words) to describe something within the image to find and mask.

threshold.tooltip: Threshold to apply to the mask, higher values will make the mask more strict. Without sufficient thresholding, CLIPSeg may include random stray content around the edges.

SwarmClipSeg.name: SwarmClipSeg
SwarmClipSeg.description: Segment an image using CLIPSeg, creating a mask of what part of an image appears to match the given text.

steps.tooltip: How many sampling steps will be ran - this is needed for per-step features (from-to/alternate/...) to work properly.

width.tooltip: Intended width of the image, used by some models (eg SDXL).

height.tooltip: Intended height of the image, used by some models (eg SDXL).

target_width.tooltip: Actual width of the image, used by some models (eg SDXL).

target_height.tooltip: Actual height of the image, used by some models (eg SDXL).

guidance.tooltip: Guidance value to embed, used by some models (eg Flux).

llama_template.tooltip: Template for the LLaMA model, if applicable.

clip_vision_output.tooltip: Optional CLIP Vision Output to use for the LLaMA model, if applicable.

images.tooltip: Optional images to use for a text-vision model, if applicable.

minimax_refs.tooltip: Optional MiniMax H3 references (images, videos, audio).

SwarmClipTextEncodeAdvanced.name: SwarmClipTextEncodeAdvanced
SwarmClipTextEncodeAdvanced.description: Acts like the regular CLIPTextEncode, but supports more advanced special features like '<break>', '[from:to:when]', '[alter|nate]', ...

SwarmCountFrames.name: SwarmCountFrames
SwarmCountFrames.description: Counts the number of frames in an image.

SwarmEmbedLoaderListProvider.name: SwarmEmbedLoaderListProvider
SwarmEmbedLoaderListProvider.description: Internal node just intended to provide a list of currently known embeddings to Swarm. You can also use it to blindly load an embedding file if you need to.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, snapped up to the model's 17k+5 grid (124 = ~5s; trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested)

SwarmEmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV.name: SwarmEmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV
SwarmEmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV.display_name: Swarm Empty MiniMax H3 AV Latent
SwarmEmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV.description: Joint video+audio latent for MiniMax H3.

SwarmEnsureAudio.name: SwarmEnsureAudio
SwarmEnsureAudio.description: Ensures audio exists and is at least the given duration

SwarmExcludeFromMask.name: SwarmExcludeFromMask
SwarmExcludeFromMask.description: Excludes the area of the exclude mask from the main mask, such that the main mask will be black in the area of the exclude mask. This is a simple subtract and clamp.

SwarmImageCompositeMaskedColorCorrecting.name: SwarmImageCompositeMaskedColorCorrecting
SwarmImageCompositeMaskedColorCorrecting.description: Works like ImageCompositeMasked, but does color correction for inpainted images (ie outside-the-mask areas are expected to be identical)

x.tooltip: The x coordinate in pixels of the top left corner of the crop.

y.tooltip: The y coordinate in pixels of the top left corner of the crop.

width.tooltip: The width in pixels of the crop.

height.tooltip: The height in pixels of the crop.

SwarmImageCrop.name: SwarmImageCrop
SwarmImageCrop.description: Crops an image to a specific region.

SwarmImageHeight.name: SwarmImageHeight
SwarmImageHeight.description: Gets the height of an image.

SwarmImageNoise.name: SwarmImageNoise
SwarmImageNoise.description: Adds random noise to an image.

width.tooltip: The target width of the image.

height.tooltip: The target height of the image.

can_shrink.tooltip: If true, the image can be shrunk to fit the target size, otherwise it will only be scaled up or left the same.

SwarmImageScaleForMP.name: SwarmImageScaleForMP
SwarmImageScaleForMP.description: Scales an image to a target width and height, while keeping the aspect ratio.

SwarmImageWidth.name: SwarmImageWidth
SwarmImageWidth.description: Gets the width of an image.

SwarmIntAdd.name: SwarmIntAdd
SwarmIntAdd.description: Adds two integers. Use a negative number to subtract.

SwarmJustLoadTheModelPlease.name: SwarmJustLoadTheModelPlease
SwarmJustLoadTheModelPlease.description: Internal node that acts as a final output for a model/clip/vae. This allows swarm to load models when needed without generating anything.

SwarmKSampler.name: SwarmKSampler
SwarmKSampler.description: Works like a vanilla Comfy KSamplerAdvanced, but with extra inputs for advanced features such as sigma scale, tiling, previews, etc.

blend_factor.tooltip: The blend factor between the two samples. 0 means entirely use sample0, 1 means entirely sample1, 0.5 means 50/50 of each.

SwarmLatentBlendMasked.name: SwarmLatentBlendMasked
SwarmLatentBlendMasked.description: Blends two latent images together within a masked region.

SwarmLoadAudioB64.name: SwarmLoadAudioB64
SwarmLoadAudioB64.description: Loads an audio from a base64 string. Works like a regular LoadAudio node, but with input format designed to be easier to use through automated calls, including SwarmUI with custom workflows.

SwarmLoadImageB64.name: SwarmLoadImageB64
SwarmLoadImageB64.description: Loads an image from a base64 string. Works like a regular LoadImage node, but with input format designed to be easier to use through automated calls, including SwarmUI with custom workflows.

SwarmLoadVideoB64.name: SwarmLoadVideoB64
SwarmLoadVideoB64.description: Loads a video from a base64 string. Works like a regular LoadVideo node, but with input format designed to be easier to use through automated calls, including SwarmUI with custom workflows.

blur_radius.tooltip: The radius of the blur kernel.

sigma.tooltip: The standard deviation of the Gaussian blur kernel.

SwarmMaskBlur.name: SwarmMaskBlur
SwarmMaskBlur.description: Blurs the contents of the mask.

grow.tooltip: Number of pixels to grow the mask by.

aspect_x.tooltip: An X width value, used to indicate a target aspect ratio. 0 to allow any aspect.

aspect_y.tooltip: A Y height value, used to indicate a target aspect ratio. 0 to allow any aspect.

SwarmMaskBounds.name: SwarmMaskBounds
SwarmMaskBounds.description: Returns the bounding box of the mask (as pixel coordinates x,y,width,height), optionally grown by the number of pixels specified in 'grow'.

grow.tooltip: Number of pixels to grow the mask by.

SwarmMaskGrow.name: SwarmMaskGrow
SwarmMaskGrow.description: Expands the contents of the max, such that masked (white) areas grow and cover the unmasked (black) areas by the number of pixels specified in 'grow'.

min.tooltip: The minimum value to threshold the mask to.

max.tooltip: The maximum value to threshold the mask to.

SwarmMaskThreshold.name: SwarmMaskThreshold
SwarmMaskThreshold.description: Thresholds the mask to the specified range, clamping any lower or higher values and rescaling the range to 0-1.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, used to crop reference videos to the generation length.

ref_image_size.tooltip: Reference image sizing. 'match' scales each ref (down only, keeping aspect) to the generation's pixel area; 'max' uses the reference pipeline's 2048px short edge for best identity fidelity.

ref_image.tooltip: Reference image (downscaled to 2048 short edge if larger, never upscaled)

ref_video_audio.tooltip: Soundtrack of the same-numbered reference video

SwarmMiniMaxH3CollectReferences.name: SwarmMiniMaxH3CollectReferences
SwarmMiniMaxH3CollectReferences.description: <Picture i> / <Video k> / <Audio j> reference collection for MiniMax H3. Feed the output into SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced.

SwarmModelTiling.name: SwarmModelTiling
SwarmModelTiling.description: Adapts a model to use circular padding to enable tiled image results. Only works on UNet based models (eg SDv1, SDXL), not on DiT models (eg SD3, Flux). Use with SwarmTileableVAE.

SwarmOverMergeMasksForOverlapFix.name: SwarmOverMergeMasksForOverlapFix
SwarmOverMergeMasksForOverlapFix.description: Merges two masks by simply adding them together, without any overlap handling. Intended for use with the Overlap nodes.

SwarmReferenceOnly.name: SwarmReferenceOnly
SwarmReferenceOnly.description: Applies 'reference only' image-prompting to the generation. Must forward the new model, and the new latent, to work properly.

SwarmSaveAudioWS.name: SwarmSaveAudioWS
SwarmSaveAudioWS.description: Acts like a special version of 'SaveAudio' that doesn't actual save to disk, instead it sends directly over websocket. This is intended so that SwarmUI can save the audio itself rather than having Comfy's Core save it.

SwarmSaveImageWS.name: SwarmSaveImageWS
SwarmSaveImageWS.description: Acts like a special version of 'SaveImage' that doesn't actual save to disk, instead it sends directly over websocket. This is intended so that SwarmUI can save the image itself rather than having Comfy's Core save it.

x.tooltip: The x position of the mask as a percentage of the image size.

y.tooltip: The y position of the mask as a percentage of the image size.

width.tooltip: The width of the mask as a percentage of the image size.

height.tooltip: The height of the mask as a percentage of the image size.

strength.tooltip: The strength of the mask, ie the value of all masked pixels, leaving the rest black ie 0.

SwarmSquareMaskFromPercent.name: SwarmSquareMaskFromPercent
SwarmSquareMaskFromPercent.description: Creates a simple square mask with the specified dimensions and position, with the specified strength (ie value of all masked pixels, leaving the rest black ie 0).

steps.tooltip: How many sampling steps will be ran - this is needed for per-step features (from-to/alternate/...) to work properly.

width.tooltip: Intended width of the image, used by some models (eg SDXL).

height.tooltip: Intended height of the image, used by some models (eg SDXL).

target_width.tooltip: Actual width of the image, used by some models (eg SDXL).

target_height.tooltip: Actual height of the image, used by some models (eg SDXL).

guidance.tooltip: Guidance value to embed, used by some models (eg Flux).

llama_template.tooltip: Template for the LLaMA model, if applicable.

clip_vision_output.tooltip: Optional CLIP Vision Output to use for the LLaMA model, if applicable.

images.tooltip: Optional images to use for a text-vision model, if applicable.

minimax_refs.tooltip: Optional MiniMax H3 references (images, videos, audio).

lora_hooks.tooltip: Optional ordered LoRA hook list referenced by //hook attachments in the prompt.

SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced.name: SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced
SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced.description: Acts like the regular CLIPTextEncode, but supports Swarm prompt tags such as '<break>', '<fromto[0.5]:a, b>', '<alternate:a, b>', '<weight[2]:text>', '<embed:name>'.

SwarmTileableVAE.name: SwarmTileableVAE
SwarmTileableVAE.description: Adapts a VAE to use circular padding to enable tiled image results. Use with SwarmModelTiling.

SwarmTrimFrames.name: SwarmTrimFrames
SwarmTrimFrames.description: Trims frames from the start and end of a video.

SwarmUnsampler.name: SwarmUnsampler
SwarmUnsampler.description: Runs sampling in reverse. The function of this is to create noise that matches an image, such that you can the run forward sampling with an altered version of the unsampling prompt to get a closely altered image. May not work on all models, may not work perfectly. Input values should largely match your Sampler inputs.

SwarmVideoBoomerang.name: SwarmVideoBoomerang
SwarmVideoBoomerang.description: Creates a boomerang effect by having the video play in reverse after the end, as a simple trick to make it appear to loop smoothly forever.

method.tooltip:
linear: each output frame is a linear blend of the two source frames bracketing its timestamp. Equivalent to ffmpeg's framerate filter. Slightly more expensive; avoids the duplicated-frame artifact. See https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#framerate
nearest: each output frame is the source frame closest in time. Equivalent to ffmpeg's fps filter. Cheap; can produce visible judder on pans. See https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#fps-1

SwarmVideoResampleFPS.name: SwarmVideoResampleFPS
SwarmVideoResampleFPS.description: Resample a video from fps_in to fps_out while preserving total duration.

TCFG.name: TCFG
TCFG.description:
TCFG – Tangential Damping CFG (2503.18137)

Refine the uncond (negative) to align with the cond (positive) for improving quality.

vae.tooltip: The VAE model used for decoding the latent.

VAEDecode.name: VAEDecode
VAEDecode.description: Decodes latent images back into pixel space images.

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to decode at a time.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to overlap.

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to encode at a time.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to overlap.
